description: The latest published summary of the child's diagnostic test, with the date it was published. If none is published yet, it returns status not_published and no results: the report isn't ready. For when the parent asks what the diagnostic said. Not for getting the diagnostic's questions, answers, or question-by-question results: it returns only the published summary, never drafts or unpublished results. Requires a connected SATCoach parent account.

child.description: The child's reference, from the list of the parent's children. Optional when the parent has one child on SATCoach.

name: get_diagnostic_report
title: Child's published diagnostic report
